cwe_content.cwe: CWE-200,Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

candidate.Reason: The code checks for admin status when returning all config values, but when a specific name is requested (line 13), it doesn't verify admin status before returning potentially sensitive config values.

This line directly returns any config value by name without checking if the config item is sensitive or if the user has admin privileges, potentially exposing sensitive information to unauthorized users.
